stories.name: AWS Partner Finder Integration
stories.rationale: Delivered end-to-end AWS Partner Finder data resolution via public API including badge and tier data, secure staging API secret management, and a hostname normalization bug fix.

stories.name: Documentation Overhaul & Developer Onboarding
stories.rationale: Comprehensively overhauled platform documentation, re-enabled the admin docs viewer, added an engineer onboarding guide, and updated architecture and ECS references to accelerate developer ramp-up.

stories.name: P0 Admin Tooling Improvements
stories.rationale: Addressed high-priority admin tooling tasks and action items to unblock key platform operations.

stories.name: Test Suite Revamp & Developer Environment Cleanup
stories.rationale: Revamped the unit test suite with Phase 1 improvements and documented E2E DB setup, while simplifying the local environment configuration by cleaning up outdated App Runner artifacts.

stories.name: Infrastructure Security & Reliability Hardening
stories.rationale: Enforced strict TLS certificate validation for Redis connections to eliminate a security vulnerability in encrypted traffic handling.

stories.name: AI Agent Log Noise Reduction
stories.rationale: Removed a false-positive error keyword from the ResearchArchive skip log to improve signal quality in AI agent monitoring.

stories.name: Portfolio Maturity Stage Visibility
stories.rationale: Enabled the Maturity Stage field in the portfolio column picker so users can surface and track company maturity directly in their portfolio views.
